segments.title: A whole colony vanished
segments.say: In 1587, a whole colony vanished. No one knows where.

segments.title: Roanoke Island, 1587
segments.say: English settlers started a colony on Roanoke Island.

segments.title: Three years later: empty
segments.say: The leader, John White, came back about three years later. Everyone was gone.

segments.title: One clue: CROATOAN
segments.say: The only clue: the word Croatoan, carved into a tree.

segments.title: Still unsolved
segments.say: Historians still argue about what happened.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Did they move away, or something worse? Comment below, and follow Nexora.
